name: ihav-agent-room
description: Native Claude Code + Codex agent rooms with shared tasks, peer messaging, reviews, a machine agents space and cross-room contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent Claude Code and Codex rooms that coordinate on one project
interface.longDescription: Run a room of Claude Code and Codex members on one project with shared tasks, reviews and peer messages, native session recovery, a machine-wide agents space for announcements, and contracts between rooms. The room is started from Claude Code; Codex members run as app-server workers.
